question: Does the unchanged adjacent-frame temporal scale-vacancy set rule cover both observations of a wholly fresh tenth 3RScan door family at IoU at least 0.5?

hypothesis_generation.deduplication: Exact candidate identity by tile, postprocess index and box coordinates; merge contributor labels without changing rank.
hypothesis_generation.vacancy_rule: Only when preserved exact deduplication leaves fewer than three candidates, append the current-frame member of the selected adjacent proposal link if it is not already present.

temporal_link.score: Mean layer-18 semantic/local fusion minus 0.05 times mean nearest-reference log-area distance.
temporal_link.tie_order: Higher path score, adjacent IoU and mean fusion, then earlier first-frame and second-frame ranked-candidate indices.

literature_motivation.use: Motivates fixed-overlap links and sequence scoring across adjacent detections.

literature_motivation.source: Leveraging Long-Range Temporal Relationships Between Proposals for Video Object Detection
literature_motivation.use: Motivates proposal-level temporal consistency without replacing frame-specific evidence.

forbidden_after_freeze: change the fresh family, five frozen images, candidate roster, models, features, contributors, penalties, link threshold, link score, tie order, exact deduplication, vacancy condition, set size or IoU gate

claim_boundary: A positive result would freshly confirm only the bounded at-most-three temporal scale-vacancy proposal-set rule on this tenth family. A negative result remains informative and cannot be repaired on this consumed family. Neither result establishes top-one localization, calibrated uncertainty, referent identity beyond this cohort, portal ownership, affordance, access, safety, waypoint, arrival or handoff.
